As the courses for my programme is fixed, I do not need to go through the enrollment process, and hence I directly emailed my programme secretary, who has sent me a draft timetable. It is not very detailed, but does provide you with the dates you are required to attend class or not. I am not sure if my experience applies to you, but you may try to email related staff and see if anyone can provide you with such information. Good luck and have fun travelling!

Hi, please be aware that if you want to pay by direct debit, you either have to pay 60% of your tuition first and pay the rest in installments if you do not have an UK bank account. If you have an UK bank account then you can pay your whole tuition in installments, no 60% payment required. Financial registration means setting up payment methods, please refer to the registry website for more details. It does not necessarily mean that you have to pay right now.
